Hi there, and thank you for reaching out to Leafy! 🌿

I don't have information about a free-shipping minimum for standard orders, so I can't say whether your $70 total after the promo code qualifies. I'd rather not guess and have you surprised at checkout.

- **Check at checkout:** your shipping cost should show on the checkout page before you pay, so you can see the final total first.
- **Leafy Plus members:** Plus includes free Standard shipping with no minimum order. It's $59/year and auto-renews. It doesn't include free Express shipping.
- **Promo codes and Plus:** a promo code can't be combined with Leafy Plus member pricing on the same item. The better discount applies automatically.

If you'd like a definite answer on free shipping for your cart, I can pass this to our team to confirm.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting! 🪴
